hero_tagline: A warm, Charlottesville community devoted to worship, prayer, and one another.
welcome_para1: Wherever you are on your journey, there's a seat for you here. Church Of The Living God is a small, close-knit congregation in Charlottesville built on genuine relationships, heartfelt worship, and the Word of God. We'd love nothing more than to meet you in person.
welcome_para2: Come as you are — you'll find open arms, warm faces, and a community that truly cares.
feature1_desc: We gather to lift our voices in genuine, Spirit-led praise. Every service is an invitation to encounter God together.
feature2_desc: We do life together — sharing meals, praying for one another, and walking through both joys and struggles side by side.
feature3_desc: We believe faith is meant to be shared. Our hands and hearts reach into Charlottesville to serve our neighbors in love.
give_para: Your generosity helps us rescue the perishing and care for the dying, right here in Charlottesville and beyond.
newsletter_sub: with Church Of The Living God
